caveats: This rollup compares seven scored/frozen 2026-05-21 external mini-campaigns and is not a project-wide benchmark.
EC/keyword routing is lane context only; it does not convert needs_review rows into mechanism_match rows.
Deterministic sequence-neighbor checks are duplicate/leakage diagnostics, not mechanism evidence.
No ESM, Foldseek, or source-free geometry sidecar was generated for these newly frozen sets, so no superiority claim is permitted.

task_definition.comparison_question: Do simple EC/keyword and deterministic sequence-neighbor baselines change terminal review-only decisions for the 2026-05-21 external mini-campaigns after adding radical SAM?
